sentences.text: Anneliese Louise van der Pol -LRB- Born September 23 , 1984 -RRB- is a Dutch and American actress , singer , model , and dancer .	singer	singing
Following her early career in musical theatre , she was best known for her role as Chelsea Daniels on That 's So Raven .
Van der Pol also has a career as a singer and has recorded several songs for The Walt Disney Company .	singer	singing	The Walt Disney Company	The Walt Disney Company
She made her Broadway debut in 2007 , and appeared Off-Broadway in 2009 .
